Acme Health About Blog App

Clinic booking software for small hospitals

Acme Health is appointment booking software built for small hospitals and clinics. Patients book on WhatsApp or the web, receive automatic reminders, and your front desk sees every booking in one dashboard. Hospitals using reminders typically see fewer missed appointments and less time spent on the phone.

How does WhatsApp booking work?

A patient messages your hospital number, picks a doctor and a free slot, and gets a confirmation instantly. The booking appears in the dashboard and in the doctor's calendar. Reminders go out the day before and two hours before the visit.

What does it cost?

Plans start with a free tier for a single doctor and scale per doctor per month. There are no setup fees, and you can export your data at any time.
